name: 5765-specdecode-7b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1: one card, one in-process engine; the draft worker inherits the target's TP.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, bounded at 512 requests / 7200 s safety, warmup the first 5% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, `request_format: plain` (raw completion string, no chat template); prompt exactly 1024 tokens, output exactly 128 with `ignore_eos`; sampling `temperature=1.0, top_p=1.0, top_k=-1, repetition_penalty=1.0`.
purpose: A seven-billion-parameter chat assistant with a draft model, answering eight concurrent page-long prompts with short replies on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.5.1-era engine args (commit 44cc76610d0b23ce5d609867f6dae7e033dee818): an unknown key is a
# TypeError at engine construction, so do not add keys from a later vLLM. The reader is line-based
# and skips indented lines, so a re-flowed or indented key silently never reaches the engine.

model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf
speculative-model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf
num-speculative-tokens: 1
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16

# Required: this engine raises without it whenever a speculative model is configured. The same
# check refuses speculative decoding together with chunked prefill, so do not add that flag.
use-v2-block-manager: true

enforce-eager: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
